title: The Blue Bird Sam Built
lines: Sam built a big bird from sticks and glue.
He made it blue with a few red dots.
The wind blew, and the bird flew up high!
It went up on the roof of the school.
A team of kids ran to help Sam.
Tim held up a long tool and got it.
The blue bird is home, and Sam grins.

questions.ask: What did Sam make his bird from?
questions.listenFor: Sticks and glue. Have them point to that line.

questions.ask: How did the bird get up on the roof?
questions.listenFor: The wind blew it up there. It did not fly by itself.

questions.ask: Would you have run to help Sam? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason of their own.
